summary: ABFS: delete call sets Socket timeout lesser than query timeout leading to failures
description:
ABFS Driver sets Socket timeout to 30 seconds and query timeout to 90 seconds. The client  will fail with SocketTimeoutException when the delete path has huge number of dirs/files before the actual query timeout. The socket timeout has to be greater than query timeout value. And it is good to have this timeout configurable to avoid failures when delete call takes more than the hardcoded configuration.
